modus_operandi: Recruiters reach out on WhatsApp/SMS claiming candidates can earn ₹2,000 - ₹5,000 daily by liking YouTube videos. After paying small initial rewards (₹150), candidates are added to a Telegram VIP group and lured to deposit ₹5,000 to ₹50,000 in 'prepaid tasks' before the scammers disappear.

scam_type: Fake TCS NQT Drive & Registration Fee
modus_operandi: Phishing emails sent from 'tcs-campus-hiring@gmail.com' claiming candidates are shortlisted for direct interview without online test. Demands ₹1,999 as 'Mandatory Hall Ticket Processing & Verification Fee' via personal UPI QR code.

scam_type: Remote Data Entry Laptop Insurance Deposit
modus_operandi: Promises $45/hour for typing scanned PDF documents. Before sending the 'company provided laptop', candidates are asked to wire $150 (₹2,500) as courier insurance, with false assurances that it will be refunded with the first paycheck.

Candidate receives a fake digital check of $3,500. They are instructed to deposit it into their bank account, keep $500, and immediately wire $3,000 via Zelle/CashApp to an 'approved vendor' for office setup. Days later, the check bounces and the student is held liable by the bank.

target_audience: Pre-Final Year Students seeking mandatory college internships
modus_operandi: Advertises full-stack internship, but informs candidate during onboarding that they must pay ₹8,500 for a 'mandatory industrial compliance kit'. Demands surrender of college marksheets and signs a ₹40,000 penalty bond if the student leaves before 6 months unpaid work.
